text: This is a game I was inspired to make after watching the documentary "Secret Mall Apartment", last year. After my first attempt, I quickly realized AI was not there yet -- I definitely don't have the talent or perseverance for game design otherwise. I recently gave it another shot, and I'm very happy with the result. It's open source at https://github.com/jacobgoldfarb/mall-bat -- please enjoy, give feedback, and feel free to contribute to make it even better.
title: Show HN: Mall Bats, a nostalgic tycoon game with a twitst
